responsibility: Implements the ISO user-exception layer by wrapping the underlying RTExceptions runtime. It allocates per-source exception blocks, raises exceptions with file/function/line metadata, copies out the current exception message text, and answers source/state/number queries, thereby bridging library-defined exception sources such as IOChan and GeneralUserExceptions to the core gm2 exception engine.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the executable implementation of EXCEPTIONS: it defines ExceptionSource as a pointer carrying an RTExceptions.EHBlock and performs the actual RTExceptions calls for allocation, raising, and querying, whereas EXCEPTIONS.def only specifies the interface.
